_comment: Example MCP registration for Claude Code. Merge the 'mcpServers' entry below into your Claude Code MCP config (e.g. `claude mcp add-json shinobi-recon '{...}'` or the equivalent in .claude/settings.json). shinobi agent already exports SHINOBI_ENGAGEMENT / SHINOBI_ENGAGEMENTS_DIR before launching the agent, so the server inherits them — no extra env config needed when launched via `shinobi agent`. SHINOBI_ENGAGEMENTS_DIR is the engagements root; a per-engagement path is not accepted.
